thread:
Ravi (Finance): Heads-up: wave-2 of the new price sheet A/B rollout is scheduled tomorrow. Need alignment on invoice-level flags and dispute flow before we flip.
Joan - Pricing: Updated rate sheet uploaded to the drive. Note vendor passthrough delta for embeddings tier.
Ethan (Billing): Biggest area to lock down: if vendor invoice arrives with a different effective date, we must not auto-pass through until vendor canary completes. Otherwise we'll have to issue manual vendor-match credits.
Marta Ops: Ops proposal: add `meta.experiment_id`, `meta.experiment_cohort`, `meta.vendor_rate_id` to every invoice line. Also `meta.grandfathered=true|false`. That should make automated recon simpler.
Nia Legal: Audit requirement: every grandfathering override needs an approver (email) + short reason. Put that in `invoice_comments.approval_reference`. Legal will store copies of approvals.
Ravi (Finance): For mid-billing-cycle converts, finance wants pro-rated credit calculation: credit = (legacy_rate - new_rate) * (remaining_seconds / billing_period_seconds) * usage. Can billing produce a CSV with computed credits?
Ethan (Billing): Yes. We'll emit daily export: `invoice_id,account_id,applied_rate,legacy_rate,computed_credit,reason_code,meta.*`. Drop to s3://recon/pricing-wave2/. Recon-bot will consume.
recon-bot: Export scheduled: daily at 01:00 UTC.
Joan - Pricing: Two edge cases: 1) Reserved commitment customers (we must not reduce committed-usage charge retroactively). 2) Accounts in vendor pass-through program. How to reconcile both?
Marta Ops: Rule: if reserved_commitment>0, only apply credits to overage portion, not committed amounts. We'll add `line_type=committed|overage` on invoice lines.
Ethan (Billing): For vendor pass-through, we need vendor mapping table. If vendor_rate_id != current_pass_through_id, hold invoice in `vendor_hold` state and flag team. Do not auto-bill until manual review.
Nia Legal: Also include `approval_escalation` metadata when someone requests an exception. Legal wants the ticket ID for future audits.
Ravi (Finance): Who owns the backfill & rollback? Billing owns backfill. Ops to provide shadow run and canary controls. Finance to validate outputs.
Marta Ops: I'll run a 5% shadow (random sample) tonight at 23:00 PT and post logs. If mismatches > 0.5% we abort.
recon-bot: Shadow run complete: 5% sample processed. mismatches: 0.4% (mostly vendor_id mapping). See logs: https://logs.redwood/shadow-wave2/1761112222
Ethan (Billing): Noted — I'll patch vendor mapping script and re-run a targeted sample.
Joan - Pricing: Also, product requested `experiment.signal_quality` in metadata so optimization analyses can join cost->quality. Add `meta.signal_quality=low|medium|high`.
Ravi (Finance): Dispute handling: if a customer disputes a mid-cycle charge related to experiment, route to `billing-disputes` queue with tag `experiment:true` and include `computed_credit` prefill. That speeds resolution.
Nia Legal: Approved: the approval trail format is acceptable. Legal needs to be CC'd on top-level approval emails.
Ethan (Billing): Timeline: vendor patch + updated export + backfill script in staging by 03:00 UTC. Rollback plan: snapshot invoices table and keep a replayable job.
Marta Ops: Canary window: 03:30-04:00 UTC tomorrow. I'll enable `vendor_hold` monitoring and slack alert if any vendor_rate mismatches.
Ravi (Finance): OK — finance signoff conditional on 0 critical mismatches in canary and vendor gating confirmed. Will post final ack after canary.
Joan - Pricing: Thanks everyone. I'll update the wave-2 runbook with the metadata schema and edge-case table.
Ethan (Billing): One more ask: add a short human-readable `invoice_reason` field for customer-facing adjustments (so support can explain credits).
Marta Ops: We can set `invoice_reason` to a templated string when auto-credit applied.
Ravi (Finance): Great. If all goes green, proceed to full rollout after canary. I'll ping again once canary is done. :thumbsup:
